• The attacks are fairly vertical & wide reaching on the primary attacks with the third attack in the combo being more narrow in the horizonal range

Internal ID: THSwordKrom | Type: Sword | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Iron x45, Bronze x30, Scale hide x15 | Attack speed: 2.16 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 3 range, 30 angle, 1.0 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. Krom is the first two-handed sword. Its primary attack is a wide 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its slower secondary attack is a thrust that deals 3x damage.

Notes. • The attacks are fairly vertical & wide reaching on the primary attacks with the third attack in the combo being more narrow in the horizonal range
• The secondary attack is a long reaching thrust that is capable of outreaching most enemies with very excellent damage.
• Brenna, found in the Smouldering Tomb dungeon, is equipped with a fiery version of Krom with a fiery explosion instead of the thrust.
• Sword is named after Crom - chief god of Cimmerians from the Conan the Barbarian book series by Robert E. Howard.
